id: Stable slug: race type + state + district/seat. Use as the key on the site.
race_type: Senate | Governor | House | Attorney General | Secretary of State | Judicial | State Legislature (Upper) | State Legislature (Lower) | Ballot Measure
district: House district number, legislative district, 'special', or measure name; null for statewide offices.
active: false = decided earlier in 2026 or not on the November ballot; exclude from rankings.
candidates: [{party, name}] as listed in the workbook (may include short annotations).
rating: Cook rating where available (House: derived band — see Provenance).
margin: Projected margin in points (null when unopposed). Candidate races: D (or the leading non-R challenger) minus R. Ballot measures: yes minus no.
display_name: Short label for the race, e.g. 'Maine Senate', 'OH-10', 'Alabama House District 3'.
margin_source: Where the margin comes from (F1 average, poll median, PVI baseline, past result + environment, ...).
sigma: Uncertainty (t-distribution scale, points) used for this race.
win_probability: Senate/Governor only: {candidate, party, opponent, p} = chance the named candidate finishes ahead.
turnout_base: Electorate size used in the turnout term (statewide 2020 turnout; district turnout for state legislature).
voter_power: 0–100 within race type (not comparable across race types). 0 = unopposed or decided.
unopposed: No opponent on the November ballot.
donation: Senate/House only: {per_dollar_power 0–100 within race type, fec_receipts (USD, nominees, cycle to date), fec_reports_through}.
caveats: Data-quality flags to show on the race page (thin polling, missing FEC reports, 3-way race, ...).
last_verified: Date the row was last checked.
